flows.title: Create a repository
steps: Select Create, then select Repository from the dropdown menu.
Select the Workspace the repository belongs in, and select a project from the Project dropdown menu. If no project exists, select Create new project at the bottom of that menu.
Enter a Repository name that describes the repository and appears in its address.
Keep access to the repository set to Private unless it should be public, so that anyone can see it.
If there are already files to put in it, select No from Include a README; otherwise keep the default or choose one of the included README options.
Select the Version control system, keeping Git as the default if the difference is unfamiliar.
Clone the repository once it is created.
